title: Make portfolio claims atomically exclusive per job
mission: Repair portfolio claim atomicity so concurrent /wc workers cannot obtain multiple live exclusive claims for the same job/dedupe_key. Preserve append-only historical evidence and stale/recovery lineage, add explicit collision receipts, and keep Live projection backward-compatible with existing portfolio claims/returns.
definition_of_done: A single job-level atomic create-if-absent/CAS uniqueness primitive determines the exclusive winner.
2-worker and 5-worker race tests prove exactly one winner and deterministic loser re-entry.
Historical claim evidence remains append-only and existing claims/returns stay readable.
Stale/recovery attempts preserve predecessor lineage rather than overwriting evidence.
Live can project winner/collision/stale/recovery/terminal state without treating duplicate claim files as concurrent authority.
The implementation is reconciled with CLAIM_PROTOCOL_SPEC_V0 and does not self-promote production /w readiness.
